unique_angle: Hemispheric specialization can be measured for defined functions and tasks, but resting-state and task-based results do not support assigning a whole-person left-brained or right-brained personality type.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed resting-state connectivity study + peer-reviewed task-based lateralization study + peer-reviewed synthesis essay
